tickets.title: US001
tickets.description:
Title:
Build Academic Roadmap

As a Student,
I want to drag and drop courses into a calendar,
so that I can visually build my academic roadmap.

Acceptance Criteria:

- Student can drag courses onto the calendar.
- Course placement updates immediately.
- Schedule changes are saved successfully.
- Conflicting time slots are highlighted.

tickets.title: US002
tickets.description:
Title:
Check Prerequisites

As a Student,
I want the system to validate prerequisites,
so that I do not choose courses I am not eligible to take.

Acceptance Criteria:

- System checks prerequisite requirements automatically.
- Invalid courses display an error message.
- Student cannot register for invalid courses.
- Validation occurs before saving the roadmap.

tickets.title: US003
tickets.description:
Title:
View Seat Availability

As a Student,
I want to see current seat availability,
so that I can choose courses with open seats.

Acceptance Criteria:

- Available seat counts are displayed.
- Full classes are clearly marked.
- Data is synchronized with the live database.
- Updates occur without page refresh.

tickets.title: US004
tickets.description:
Title:
Receive Schedule Warnings

As a Student,
I want to receive warnings for early classes,
so that I can avoid creating schedules that do not fit my preferences.

Acceptance Criteria:

- Warning appears for classes beginning before 8:00 AM.
- Student can continue despite the warning.
- Warning message explains the reason.

tickets.title: US005
tickets.description:
Title:
Override Prerequisites

As an Advisor,
I want to override prerequisite restrictions,
so that students with special permission can enroll.

Acceptance Criteria:

- Advisor can override prerequisite rules.
- A justification is required.
- Override actions are recorded in the audit log.
- Students can register after approval.

analysis.ambiguity1: The system needs to stop them from even asking.This requirement is ambiguous because it does not specify how the system should prevent students from asking prerequisite-related questions. It is unclear whether the system should block emails, provide automatic answers, display prerequisite information proactively, or use another mechanism. The expected system behavior is not clearly defined.
analysis.ambiguity2: I want the app to warn me if I'm choosing a class that starts at 8:00 AM because I will definitely oversleep.This requirement is ambiguous because it is based on a personal preference rather than a measurable rule. It is unclear whether the warning should apply only to 8:00 AM classes, all morning classes, or be configurable by each student.
analysis.conflictSolution:
Conflict:

The Registrar requires the system to prevent students from adding full classes to their roadmap because seat availability comes from the live database.

The Head of Advising wants students to plan four years ahead, even when future seat availability is unknown.

Proposed Solution:

Implement two planning modes:

1. Academic Planning Mode:
Students may add any course to a long-term roadmap regardless of current seat availability.

2. Registration Mode:
Students may only register for courses that currently have available seats.

This solution supports long-term planning while maintaining accurate enrollment controls.
